Name: ChasePlane
Description: Control ChasePlane (MSFS 2024) from your Stream Deck: switch to any Internal, External or World camera view, toggle cinematic mode and the flashlight. Keys light up while the view or feature is active.

fr.stalexcorp.msfschaseplane.camera.Name: Camera
fr.stalexcorp.msfschaseplane.camera.Tooltip: Switch to a ChasePlane camera view. The key is highlighted while the view is active.

fr.stalexcorp.msfschaseplane.cinematic.Name: Cinematic
fr.stalexcorp.msfschaseplane.cinematic.Tooltip: Toggle ChasePlane cinematic mode. The key is highlighted while it is on.

fr.stalexcorp.msfschaseplane.flashlight.Name: Flashlight
fr.stalexcorp.msfschaseplane.flashlight.Tooltip: Toggle the ChasePlane flashlight. The key is highlighted while it is on.
